$comment: Self-derived finetype drift contract for cms/hcpcs, checked by the in-engine finetype_validate@1 gate (the model-free `ft_validate` DuckDB table macro). ft_validate MELTS every column to VARCHAR, so this contract uses ONLY the string-surviving JSON-Schema keywords. ENFORCED: the `pattern` on code and code_display, a letter other than D and four digits, the shape descriptor.overrides.json publishes and narrower than finetype's canonical `identity.medical.hcpcs` (`^[A-V]\d{4}$`) by the D series; the closed `enum` domains on level, text_source, action_code, coverage_code, multiple_pricing_indicator and asc_payment_group, as CMS's record layout defines them; the BETOS shape (a letter, a digit and an optional letter); the release pattern; and `minLength`/`maxLength` envelopes elsewhere. NOT ENFORCED, by design: numeric ranges and dates (a numeric `type` BACKFIRES to 100% reject once melted to VARCHAR); NULLs (invisible to ft_validate); object-level `required` (documentation only); and the four list columns, which do not melt to a string shape. Free-text fields (description, description_full, corpus) carry LOOSE length envelopes with headroom; short_description holds CMS's 28-character limit. Derived from build/stage/hcpcs.parquet: a pass-through on today's 8,770 rows, a fail-closed tripwire for future drift (an unknown action or coverage code, a malformed or dental code).
title: cms/hcpcs
